summary:
ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF PENNSYLVANIA.

The case is stated in the opinion.
attorneys: Mr. David W. Sellers for plaintiff in error., No appearance for defendants in error.

opinions.author: Chase
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Chase

delivered the opinion of the court.

Mr. David W. Sellers for plaintiff in error. No appearance for defendants in error.

The same questions substantially are presented in this case as in the ease of Bronson v. Rodes, 7 Wall. 229, heretofore decided at this term. The principles settled by that judgment require that the judgment of the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania be affirmed, and it is so ordered. Affirmed.
